description: This file defines a class `AzureTableStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder` implementing the `IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>` interface, responsible for configuring Azure Table Storage based grain storage in Orleans. It sets up connection options by reading configuration sections, handles external service dependencies, and registers a provider for Orleans silo builders.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements the configuration logic for Azure Table Storage grain storage in Orleans, initializing connection parameters based on provided configuration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the `ISiloBuilder` with Azure Table Storage settings, including table name, connection details, and serializer based on configuration sections.
